I4F3reYAXX.description: Spawn a random zombie every 4 seconds! (Lvl3=Zombie, Conehead Zombie, Buckethead Zombie, Trashcan Zombie, Football Zombie, Newspaper Zombie, Jack in the Box Zombie, Balloon Zombie, Zombomb)

PcIyY8AJg8.description:
Cost: 50

Generates 25+ Braains every wave for every Zombie Boss.

FjjBQ0unkH.name: Spawn Cob Cannon
FjjBQ0unkH.description: Spawns a cob cannon that has a long cooldown but can do damage equal to a cherry bomb.

KNOsAu7DXs.name: Spark
KNOsAu7DXs.description: Use this to take away any metal object from a zombie - dealing 70 damage with each spark! Can only be used every 8 seconds.

s2Jg4QFJ9d.name: Raiding Party

Cost: 1000

Spawns a lot of bungee zombies along with a ton of normal zombies as well! 60 second cooldown.

SgL6524dPw.name: Air Raid
SgL6524dPw.description:
Cost: 700

Spawns a lot of balloon zombies and newspaper zombies! 50 second cooldown.

oNPQ1Pxryf.name: Shoot Electricity
oNPQ1Pxryf.description: Shoot electricity at your enemies! Has a capacity of 100 bolts, and does 15 damage per bolt. Reload cost is based on how much electricity you used, 100 = 200 braains.. Press R to reload.

VSLM6uvZNi.name: Acorn Minigun
VSLM6uvZNi.description: A hard, rough, acorn pellet will make sure the lawn doesn't get attacked again.

PAOsqeZMP6.name: Stuffed Acorn
PAOsqeZMP6.description: Kaboom! Explosions! [R] to reload! Costs 750 Sun to refill.

NGcX4LMNQ0.name: Solar Beam
NGcX4LMNQ0.description: Blast your enemies! Dead zombies has a chance to also produce sun! You also produce 50 sun each time a wave ends.

xOgt6pwPX4.name: Healing Dome
xOgt6pwPX4.description: You can now heal everyone in your little dome! 10 HP healed per second. <b>Cooldown: 10 Seconds<b/>

acrPo4xcNH.name: Super Healing Dome
acrPo4xcNH.description: You can now heal everyone in your little dome! 100 HP healed per second. <b>Cooldown: 25 Seconds<b/>

lR3p2RzO1H.name: Twin Healing Dome
lR3p2RzO1H.description: You can now heal everyone in your little dome! 20 HP healed per second. <b>Cooldown: 13 Seconds<b/>

PCUAFxH3qo.name: Twin Sun Beam

LPt7WNHhvh.name: Triple Flame
LPt7WNHhvh.description: Burn some zombies together with some fire! But beware, it will speed them up by 0.05!

2EJSAM77fV.name: Queen's Servants
2EJSAM77fV.description: Summons 2 Sunny Servants. Each time they shoot a zombie, you gain 2 HP back. <b>Cooldown: 60 Seconds<b/>

C7IpzpqpjW.name: Gold Spark
C7IpzpqpjW.description: Zombies killed by this item will make you gain 10 coins!

yYs4qavsWq.name: Collect Coins
yYs4qavsWq.description: Collect all the coins around you! 7 second cooldown.

yVsDplxqBO.name: Feline Spike-Shot
yVsDplxqBO.description: Shoot multiple enemies at once! The spike-shots aim to the closet zombie near you! You can also kill special zombies with this plant!

G3vU0vrakM.name: Spawn Cattail
G3vU0vrakM.description: Spawns a cattail that is basically a cactus but can aim spikes towards the closet zombie!

ZiJ7FYJfBa.name: Spawn Tallnut
ZiJ7FYJfBa.description: Spawns a tallnut that blocks zombies, basically a buffed wallnut.

6qilv2yiAP.name: Spawn Fume-Shroom
6qilv2yiAP.description: Spawns a fume-shroom that shoots through zombies.

BH2snWDGPa.name: Spawn Magnet-Shroom

jxJPkZQsbe.description: Shoot a bullet every 1 second that does 50 damage!
jxJPkZQsbe.name: T-09 Gun

Spawn 17 Bungee Targets around you! 25 second cooldown.

Cost: 300

Has 1000 health and can knock back plants away. Does 90 damage and has 1.5 second cooldown.

yzbwqWyNut.name: Hypnoblast

tluwMXpHAA.name: Blow
tluwMXpHAA.description: Very useful for the fog and SOME zombies!

vM911yJOsO.description: Activating this turns Solar Beam into Charge Beam. While using Charge Beam, you cannot move and using it will take up Sun Power. When you're all out of Sun Power, this disables instantly and you have to wait 45 seconds until you can use it again. Using this again disables Charge Beam and turns it back into Solar Beam.

xwUNmpMpUu.name: Remove Zombwalls
xwUNmpMpUu.description: Incase you somehow get stuck. Removes all walls, getting 75% of the braains from all of them. Like Seriously, how'd you get yourself stuck???

ir31lwGndI.name: Charge Beam
ir31lwGndI.description: Use your mouse cursor to shoot at zombies! 10 damage per shot!

QsaZLAQf4f.name: Cabbage
QsaZLAQf4f.description: Hurl some egges at your enemies!

PKo2T7Cr6d.name: Pepper
PKo2T7Cr6d.description: Hurl some peppers that do group damage at your enemies!

WSe4bNmZLU.name: Starshoot
WSe4bNmZLU.description: Shoot in five directions at once!

Has 2000 health and shoots faster and does more damage.

u8rJfYUylY.name: Overbean

nlIDpx7aXz.name: Super Shield

bKBfoWvD4w.name: Teleportation
bKBfoWvD4w.description: Teleport to your mouse cursor. Cooldown: 15 seconds. Each use depletes 1 of your teleports and you regain 2 teleports every wave.

rVEoc4i3Sq.name: GargCharge
rVEoc4i3Sq.description: Charge at any enemy closeby, doing a whopping 1000 damage to them! 10 second coooldown.

taSk1hfX8n.name: Toxic Spit
taSk1hfX8n.description: Spit purple goop that damages zombies and slows them down!

Afn4pg1hoV.name: Black Hole
Afn4pg1hoV.description: Make a black hole at your mouse cursor, which drags in zombies. Lasts for 7 seconds, and recharge is 18 seconds.

SHdPieJvRy.name: Temporary Zombgunner
SHdPieJvRy.description:
Has only 2 uses.

Has 1000 health and can knock back plants away. Does 90 damage and has 1.5 second cooldown.

NuAEeyNZp7.name: Temporary Zombgunner 2
NuAEeyNZp7.description:
Has only 3 uses.

Has 2000 health and shoots faster and does more damage.

6n1uXDyvG6.name: Healy Thingy
6n1uXDyvG6.description: Heals all zombies in radius of it

V59ztkcRXY.name: Temporary Healing Station
V59ztkcRXY.description:
Has only 1 use.

Heals 5% of a zombies maximum health each second, cant heal itself

Ax6QqNBq11.name: Golden Peashoot
Ax6QqNBq11.description: Shoot your enemies with style and better damage!

hgF4gXhI8Z.name: Ice Spike-Shot
hgF4gXhI8Z.description: Shoot multiple enemies and freeze them all at once! You can also kill special zombies with this plant!

GsPbtKwFzU.name: Maple Peashoot
GsPbtKwFzU.description: Shoot your enemies and stun them with random chance!

RTXbtIrLsz.name: Twink
RTXbtIrLsz.message: Welcome to Crazy Dave's Twinkydiddies! If you buy a plant for coins, you will the have to use sun to be it, as it will not make you spend coins again. FALL SALE! Everything is 2.5% Off!

1RnTTtzKk5.name: Night
1RnTTtzKk5.message: These plants can only be used in the night or fog section. (unless activated by a coffee bean which you cant get right now cuz it doesnt exist)

options.name: Be Royal Hypno Flower for FREE

RtBq7K8vmT.name: Zombie Bosses
RtBq7K8vmT.message: Spawn as a boss on the zombies side! Only three bosses is allowed at a time, no boss of the same type, and no boss can spawn when one dies, as there is a 3 minute cooldown when the boss dies.

options.name: Zommander (10000 Coins) Good at spawning zombies, bad at defending itself from high HP plants
Titan (25000 Coins) Good at attacking, weakness is ranged plants
T-09 Undead (15000 Coins) Good at defending, takes half the damage from explosions/fire, bad at attacking
Sasquatch (20000 Coins) Good at offense, bad at defense

jiC1vwR43j.name: Warning
jiC1vwR43j.message: Are you sure you want to go back to the selection screen?

39HIS09Y4B.name: Plant Bosses
39HIS09Y4B.message:
Plant Bosses are the opposite of Zombie Bosses. There can only be three bosses at a time! You can kill zombies much more faster, summon units, and dominate overall..
FALL SALE! Everything is 15% off!

options.name: Giga Torchwood (14355 Coins) Great at attacking, weakness is being slow
Royal Hypno Flower (12958 Coins) Great at crowd control, bad at attacking
Sunflower Queen (9994 Coins) Great at support, weakness is low health
Super Bean (6795 Coins) Great for mowing down groups, bad against zombies like Zombonis or Gargantuars.
